h: NDC reportedly unveils its 2027 campaign council with Peter Obi, Kwankwaso and Dickson
p: The Nigeria Democratic Congress has reportedly named its campaign council for the 2027 elections. The list is said to include presidential candidate Peter Obi, his running mate Rabiu Kwankwaso and party leader Seriake Dickson.
more: The announcement follows weeks of meetings in Abuja over the council's make-up.
The party had earlier dismissed reports of division over the Obi-Kwankwaso ticket.
